lines: Alloys with 40%, 50% and 80% gold are mixed to get 30 kg of a 55% gold alloy. The first alloy is 9 kg. How many kg of the third alloy is used?
working: Rest: 21 kg must give 12.9 kg gold
content.takeaway: Write one equation for the {b:gold}. The total weight gives the second.
